verdict.rationale: Fivetran is a SaaS platform that handles customer data and ships AI features, such as an AI support assistant and an AI context layer, so an AI-training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question. The evidence pack contains no statement about whether customer data is used to train AI models, nor any opt-out control. Data blocking and column hashing only govern what gets synced to the destination, not AI training use.
